title: What people frame, i
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: A customer a day. Monday: a 1971 wedding photo, water-stained at one corner. The woman wants the stain inside the mat. 'That's the year it rained on us.'

panels.composition: Heceta Frame & Matting. WOOD at the counter. A WOMAN in her fifties with a photograph in a paper bag. The OWNER at the mat cutter behind.

balloons.text: It's from '71. Don't cut the corner off.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, xerox grain, stark black spotting, a young man at a frame-shop counter taking a photograph from a paper bag held by a middle-aged woman, an older woman at a mat cutter behind them

panels.composition: The photo: a couple on a dock — this dock, Gully's uncle's dock — in rain, in 1971, laughing. The corner stained.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, xerox grain, stark black spotting, close-up of a water-stained 1971 wedding photograph of a couple laughing on a wooden dock in rain
image.notes: It's the dock. The strip doesn't say so. The reader who knows the dock knows.

panels.composition: Wood laying the mat window over it, the stain inside the window.

balloons.text: That's the year it rained on us.
